prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: square full-bleed birthday invitation background, live English/Georgian text added later by website.
Input image: edit target, existing Paper Garland birthday artwork. Redesign this artwork substantially to become tasteful modern watercolor stationery while keeping its garland-and-cake theme.
Primary request: a restrained classy watercolor birthday invitation. Soft almost-white warm ivory cotton paper, fine subtle grain, at least 75% quiet negative space. At the very top, a single delicate gently drooping string of 7 small plain watercolor triangular pennants in dusty blush, muted sage, pale warm ochre and one soft mauve. Keep all bunting within the top 15% of canvas; use a light fine string and tiny soft attachment details. No patterns on pennants. A small elegant watercolor pink birthday cake centered near the bottom, spanning only x38%-62%, from y76% to y95% including five slim lit candles and a low simple cream ceramic pedestal. The cake should feel hand painted with transparent pigment, soft imperfect edges, economical brushstrokes, understated cream piping and a few delicate muted sprinkles, plausible proportions. Candles in the same restrained blush/sage/ochre colors, small realistic warm flames. A tiny soft grounding wash only directly under the cake.
Remove the huge tissue flowers, all long streamers, all side decorations, floating hearts and the confetti carpet. No ribbon frame or enclosing border. No glossy 3D rendering, plastic frosting, strong outlines, excessive microtexture, saturated turquoise or yellow. This is original boutique stationery inspired by minimalist watercolor bunting and cake invitations, not a copy of any specific design.
Layout constraints: keep x12%-88%, y19%-70% completely light and empty for editable centered text. Nothing crosses this area. Cake is small and isolated at the bottom, never crowding center copy. Full-bleed single square image; not a photographed card, not a mockup, no inset paper panel. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermark.

Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: tall portrait 9:16 birthday invitation background, live text added later by website.
Input image 1: edit target, original portrait Paper Garland card. Input image 2: style and motif reference, newly redesigned square Paper Garland watercolor card. Redesign image 1 to match image 2 exactly in paint handling, palette, sparse decoration and cake appearance, while retaining the tall 9:16 output.
Primary request: classy modern watercolor birthday stationery with softly off-white warm ivory cotton paper and fine subtle grain. At the very top, ONE delicate gently drooping string of 7 small plain watercolor pennants in dusty blush, sage, pale ochre and soft mauve, on a fine light string. Keep the banner entirely in the upper 12% of the tall card. No patterns. At the bottom center, paint the SAME small pink cake, five striped lit candles and simple cream ceramic pedestal seen in image 2. Natural proportions, soft translucent watercolor, restrained piping and sparse sprinkles. Cake and candles combined span x32%-68% and y74%-95%; preserve unpainted margins beneath the pedestal.
Remove all original big tissue flowers, trailing streamers, side motifs, confetti and hearts. No enclosing frame. Keep the expansive center x12%-88%, y18%-69% clear and light for editable centered text.
Original boutique stationery aesthetic, simple brushwork, softly varied edges, muted colors. No glossy 3D, heavy contours, uniform noisy texture, saturated rainbow colors, mockup or photographed card. No lettering, text, numbers, logo or watermark. Output only a full-bleed tall 9:16 card background.
